sources.FDACS: Authoritative for Florida Chapter 507 state mover registration.
sources.MIAMI_DADE_MOVING: Authoritative for Miami-Dade Moving Business Registration / License (MR-#####).
sources.MIAMI_DADE_LBT: Authoritative for county Local Business Tax observations — NOT mover authority.
sources.FMCSA: Authoritative for federal/interstate regulatory identity where applicable.

conflict_types.JURISDICTIONAL_DIFFERENCE: Both facts can be correct (different regulators / jurisdictions). Preserve both with provenance.
conflict_types.TEMPORAL_DIFFERENCE: Retrieval or effective dates differ; both observations may be historically correct.
conflict_types.BRANCH_CANDIDATE: Possible additional location / branch — not proven without explicit branch record.
conflict_types.IDENTITY_REVIEW: Potentially different businesses. Plausible overlap without deterministic same-entity proof.
conflict_types.TRUE_DATA_CONFLICT: Same fact / same jurisdiction / same time window genuinely conflicts. Preserve both; do not silently overwrite.
conflict_types.CROSS_SOURCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Needs human review before any canonical attachment.

provenance_rule: Every retained observation must keep source agency, source URL/record id, and retrieval timestamp.
